title: Settings
subtitle: Your preferences and, for admins, workspace administration.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Switches the interface between English and Arabic, including text direction.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Light or dark. Follows your system setting unless you choose one.

mcp.title: MCP access
mcp.intro: Connect an MCP client such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor to this workspace. The client acts as you and can never do more than you can. Choose below exactly which abilities each token gives it; workspace administration (members, agents, integrations) always stays in the browser.
mcp.unavailable: MCP access is not configured on this deployment yet. An administrator needs to set INSFORGE_API_KEY and INSFORGE_JWT_SECRET.
mcp.name: Token name
mcp.scopeHint: Grant only what the client needs. Each token is shown once; revoke it here if it is lost or no longer needed.
mcp.createdOnce: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.

errors.forbidden: Only active members can create tokens.
errors.invalid: Check the token name and options.
errors.limit: You already have 10 active tokens. Revoke one first.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.

read.label: Read
read.hint: Products, tasks, members, releases, knowledge, lifecycle and channels. Always included.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.hint: Create, edit, complete and reopen tasks; watch them; scope them into releases.

products.label: Products
products.hint: Create and edit products, post status updates, set risk tiers.

lifecycle.label: Lifecycle
lifecycle.hint: Edit phase owners and notes, move phases (including waivers), add evidence.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.hint: Create, edit, publish and archive articles, notes and sources; create tags.

releases.label: Releases
releases.hint: Create and edit releases, tick checklist items, move releases through to shipped.

channels.label: Channels & messages
channels.hint: Post messages and replies, create channels, read and send direct messages.

attachments.label: Files & attachments
attachments.hint: Upload files and attach them to tasks, status updates, messages, knowledge and lifecycle evidence; set product logos.

delete.label: Delete
delete.hint: Permanently delete tasks, status updates, knowledge items, releases, messages and evidence; archive products.
